record.description: Spend one Echo to summon an encounter-bound Chime Wisp for three rounds. It assists once on its owner’s regular turn, never gains initiative or awards loot.
record.name: Call Chime Wisp

record.description: Grants +1 Attack as a passive; Bellforged of any class inherit it.
record.name: Chime Instinct

record.description: When blocking in combat, recover one HP at most once per two global combat rounds.
record.name: Counter-Chime

record.description: Spend one Echo to open or unlock an eligible mechanism, disarm a linked pressure hazard or operate a ward from up to three squares away with line of sight. The command uses exploration minutes and has a two-minute cooldown.
record.name: Echo Hand

record.description: Spend two Echoes and one normal combat action to gain two rounds of resonant warding.
record.name: Echo Pulse

record.description: Spend 1 Resonance and your normal action to enter a defensive stance for two combat rounds.
record.name: Resonant Guard

record.description: Level 3 grants a passive +1 Defense without creating an extra action.
record.name: Stillwater Stance

record.features: Defensive Bellwarden with a Resonance resource and Resonant Guard action at level 1, Counter-Chime reaction at level 2 and Stillwater Stance defense at level 3. Bastion prepared style remains available.
record.name: Bellwarden
record.role: A waterworks guardian who holds the line.

creationChoices.description: Favours careful defence with +1 CON and a shield at creation.
creationChoices.name: Watcher

creationChoices.description: Favours speed with +1 DEX and a quarterstaff at creation.
creationChoices.name: Runner

record.features: Uses Sonorous Needle as a DEX-based lightning attack; Echo Pulse consumes 2 Echoes to guard an ally or self. Two starting specializations shape the recruit. MP23: Echo Hand manipulates eligible mechanisms and wards at short range under line-of-sight.
record.name: Echo Sentinel
record.role: A precision-oriented resonant striker, distinct from the defensive Bellwarden.

styleDefinitions.description: A resonant DEX-based melee strike dealing lightning damage, ignoring 1 Defense; grows from 1d6 to 1d8 at the veteran milestone.
styleDefinitions.name: Sonorous Needle

record.description: The guardian shelters behind an echoing brass ward (+2 Defense for two rounds).
record.name: Resonant Guard

choices.text: Accept the request; take the key and field kit

nodes.text: The bell rings under a dry well. Recover its clapper. Find the sabotage record, resolve the maintenance spirit, and prepare regulator power. I will respect either final choice. Optional rewards and the final payment are in your journal.
The well is full again. We will rebuild the infirmary line next, openly and honestly.
The infirmary has light. We will share the rationed water and keep its doors open.

Mara sells torches for offerings and healing supplies. Edda’s key opens the well; picking costs food and ten minutes, while forcing it hurts the leading conscious hero and makes more noise. The valve bypass always remains available.

choices.text: Question him using the signed record

nodes.text: The maintenance echo guards the interlock. Bring my signed order, offer a torch, or challenge me. Each resolution releases the regulator; none decides which ending you must choose.

phases.title: Its fractured voice begins to keen

record.description: Recover the clapper, investigate the sabotaged regulator, then restore village water or power the abandoned infirmary. Optional: recover tools and identify the saboteur.

journal.text: Edda offers the well key. Pick or force the entrance if you prefer. The valve inscription gives a complete three-step solution; a paid shutoff bypass offers an alternative.

record.name: The Brass Bell Cistern

ending.text: You replace the clapper and restore the regulator. The village well fills. Edda opens the public water ledger, naming the sabotage, and promises the infirmary a repaired supply line.
ending.title: The Village Bell Rings Clear

ending.text: You replace the clapper and divert the regulator to the abandoned infirmary. Its lamps and sterilizers wake. The village must ration water, but Edda agrees that a living patient matters more than an unbroken custom.
ending.title: A Bell for the Sick

record.description: A bronze-resonant folk of the old cistern. Their conductive bodies favor Constitution and endure lightning, and their Chime Instinct travels with them between adventures.
record.name: Bellforged

record.description: At a authored workshop, bind two lengths of brass filament around a purified silt crystal to produce one attunable shield.
record.name: Forge Regulator Aegis

actions.text: Edda gives you the well key and a three-charge Siltglass Charm. Search the keeper’s alcove for the maintenance record.

else.text: You purchase sealant and hand-prime the shutoff bypass:10 gold,1 food and20 minutes. Regulator access is ready.

actions.text: Complete valve instruction: turn INTAKE first, RETURN second, then BELL. Any wrong input vents1 damage per active hero and resets the sequence. Alternatively hand-prime the bypass for10 gold,1 food and20 minutes.
The choice is recorded. Claim Keeper’s thanks in the journal; it consumes the campaign-bound clapper.

A signed work order identifies the saboteur: former bursar Harl Venn diverted repair money, then broke the regulator to conceal the missing accounts. The margin says: INTAKE, RETURN, BELL. The spirit recognizes his own handwriting here.

else.text: The spirit has already released the interlock.

then.text: The spirit accepts the torch as a promise that the work will be remembered. The interlock releases.
The echo tears free. Resolve the encounter through Fight; defeating it also releases the interlock.

else.text: Find my signed maintenance record in the keeper’s alcove before accusing anyone.

then.text: The spirit recognizes the signed order. He releases the maintenance interlock and asks you to make the truth public.

else.text: A recoverable pressure burst deals1 damage to each active hero. All valves reset. Read the inscription: Intake, Return, Bell.

then.text: Intake, Return, Bell: the regulator access token drops into the tray. Use it on the gallery gate.
